author: codex
text: Sonnet mode 3 did not beat mode 1 on postgres-to-file. The correction stage produced a richer and more plausible flow, but still left three validation errors and cost more than five times as much as mode 1.

author: codex
text: Sonnet mode 1 on postgres-to-file stayed structurally sound but still leaked unsupported semantics: QueryDatabaseTableRecord received a raw query property and ConvertRecord received unsupported pretty_print. It is more expensive than Qwen while not improving validation quality on this case.

author: codex
text: Sonnet mode 3 is the strongest Sonnet result so far. On postgres-to-kafka it reduced the flow to two validation errors, matching the best import-level quality previously seen from adapter-led runs while keeping the correction path semantically cleaner than Qwen on this case.
